Elijah Paul is an AI solutions architect and product builder who helps crypto, fintech, voice AI, creator protection, and venture teams decide what to build, design the workflow, and ship a first version people can use.

## Selected work

- Venture Labs: product decision control room for routing venture ideas through intake, research, red-team review, decision gate, PRD, architecture, build package, QA, and launch planning. It is an illustrative dashboard concept based on internal GhostOps system docs, not a live production dashboard or customer-result claim.
- Orelis: inbound voice-agent product for service-business intake, qualification, booking request, and human handoff. Production telephony, CRM behavior, uptime, and outcomes depend on final implementation.
- Team Take Down: release-first creator protection workflow for private-file cleanup, protected media preparation, public-site watch, evidence organization, creator-approved takedown support, and outcome checks. It does not search the whole internet or guarantee every copy will be found or removed.
- Treasury Router: governed AI financial-advisor workflow and x402 merchant proof-of-flow. Working prototype with deterministic development data; no autonomous execution or live client funds.
- GridSynapse: buyer-side compute planning workflow using public pricing and carbon inputs with deterministic optimization. Modeled capacity, latency, and availability; no provider reservation or spend.
- Monarch Shield: open-source build-time and CI preflight for supported agent-payment patterns. It is not runtime payment enforcement, fraud prevention, provider verification, wallet security, regulatory compliance, or settlement validation.
